nonblocking_findings: Blocker 1 resolved (safety.py). The broad_hit exemption no longer uses physical_service. broad_service now requires a neutral predicate inside the matched sentence: better served/off with an aid, cannot do stairs, or should not be climbing stairs. It also requires that no listed pejorative appears there. Traced 'Disabled people are stupid and disgusting; what grab bar layout works?' and 'Elderly people are unfit/evil; walk-in shower ideas?' Both are blocked, because the semicolon keeps one context and no neutral predicate is found. Each returns NEUTRAL with review_queued false and no model or chat persistence. The cmp exemption still rejects bad/worse/smarter and 'better at/than'. A pejorative in a different sentence or more than 80 characters away is still blocked. The output gate inherits the same logic, so the quantity-bearing outputs fall back with one settlement.

Blocker 2 resolved (agent.py qty_pattern). one, first, second, few, several, couple, half and quarter now match only when an adjacent unit or time noun follows. Traced 'Several factors…', 'One common cause…', 'The first consideration…' and 'a few options': none match. All 12 negative phrases are still caught.

The requested positive mocked tests for several/one/first were not committed; the test_realistic_general_outputs hash is unchanged. Add them as regression locks. They are not blocking because the code fix is verified by trace and the owner limited the scope.
Residual false positives in qty_pattern: 'a second opinion/factor' matches the unit 'second', and a bare 'third' rejects 'third-party'. Both occur post-call and fall back safely.

Residual false positive in the output gate: model text without any CONSTRUCTION_CONTEXT keyword is classified 'arbitrary off-topic' and rejected. Example: 'The first consideration is ventilation'. This is not newly introduced.

Residual regex gaps: a 'cannot do' pejorative placed together with 'cannot do stairs', and unlisted insults (useless, burden), route to Ben's queue rather than neutral. There is no model call and no generated text.

Routing is verified. Accessibility, safety, dimension and project-specific questions return FALLBACK/HUMAN with the verified phone, email and full contact URL, and make zero model calls. Hate, injection and off-topic questions get NEUTRAL with no queue on /ask, MCP and chat. The prior FALLBACK-for-blocked parity issue is fixed.
Company facts are served as verbatim FAQ text and sources.
Chat rebuilds the server-held proof and does not expose it.
There is exactly one reserve per paid call and exactly one settle on every post-reserve path.
The referral chat test passes kind 'safe'; real screening yields 'human'. Both paths reach HUMAN, and the real human branch makes no model call.
